data_fields.name: hash_weight_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: n++ * (1 + actor id) * field hash

best_idea: Record each fight as seed, input log and rule version, and re-run it on the server in tests with a per-tick hash over id-ordered state, so the first divergent tick is named.
decision_why: Keep the per-tick id-ordered state hash and the replay-from-seed-and-inputs check for fight record/replay (row 19); reject the lockstep wait because our server is the authority and must not wait on clients; fold the RNG state (donor defect fixed).
acceptance: A server test records a 3-on-1 fight from one seed and an input log, re-runs it from the seed, and asserts the hash matches every tick; changing one damage constant makes the test name the first differing tick.
